name: delivery-check-drift-advisory
title: Adopt a signed storyFilesHash drift-advisory for the delivery-check DONE gate
description: The DONE delivery-check freshness gate binds the whole-tree materialHash, so any unrelated main merge re-stales a freshly-signed delivery-check and forces the lattice-review-delivery reviewer to re-sign the byte-identical story diff. Fold a signed storyFilesHash into delivery-check and downgrade pure whole-tree drift to a mandatory re-attestation advisory, while story-owned changes still hard-reject.
